webster.text: Keeping company; having frequent or customary intercourse; intimately associating; familiar by fellowship or cohabitation; acquainted.

more.text: Acquainted by familiar use or study.
Concerning; having concern, or relation to; having for its object; followed by about.

example.quote: What the consequences of this system have been, is within the knowledge of every man the least conversant in our public affairs, and has been amply unfolded in different parts of these inquiries.
